title: Paloma and the Veil
author: Wren Quintana
blurb: Ines Winterbourne, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
